rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The party organ reports that on the 28th 公明党 held its 15th national convention in Tokyo and that the new executive led by 石井啓一代表 was launched ('公明党は28日、結党60年の節目を刻む第15回全国大会を都内で開き、石井啓一代表ら新執行部が発足しました').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: In the interview 石井啓一 says he received the appointment as party representative as the successor of 山口那津男前代表 ('山口那津男前代表の後任として党代表を拝命しました').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: In the same answer he describes his predecessor as '8期15年にわたり党の発展をリードされた山口那津男前代表'.
